data.title: Carbon Accounting
data.description:
The Carbon Accounting Mini Academy is an intensive, hands-on program designed to equip you with in-demand carbon accounting skills. Learn how to measure, calculate, and report GHG emissions using global standards and real industry tools, explore carbon markets and Indonesia’s carbon trading landscape, and gain practical experience through real case studies and software simulations. Become job-ready to drive sustainability and decarbonization in just 2 months!

Perfect for fresh graduates, career shifters, and green employees ready to level up in sustainability 🌱💼

topics.title: Introdution to Carbon Accounting
topics.description: Exploring definition, key concept, global trend, best practices and CA career path.

topics.title: Standards, Principles & Regulations
topics.description: Understanding CA principles, framework ((GHG Protocol (scope 1,2,3), ISO 14064, IPCC, SBTi), global & local regulations, and boundary setting.

topics.title: Scope 1, 2 & 3
topics.description: Deep dive on Scope 1, 2 & 3 (Emission factors, Data collection & quantification, Calculation Method & analysis)

topics.title: Value Chain
topics.description: Understanding value chain emission & the difference between value chain emissions and embedded carbon.

topics.title: Tools & Digital Carbon Accounting
topics.description: Exploring tools and software commonly used in Carbon Accounting (ex: Persefoni, Greenly, Emitwise, Envizi, Simapro) for more complex calculations (real-world software use cases), Data integration & automation, Data management & monitoring.

topics.title: Reporting, Verification, Mitigation Strategies & Decarbonization Roadmap
topics.description: Learning Report Framework (ex: GRI, CDP, TCFD, CSRD, PROPER), Audit & verification ISO 14064, Making decarbonization roadmap.

topics.title: Carbon Market & Carbon Trading
topics.description: Understanding definition and concepts of the carbon market and carbon trading, Differences between compliance markets and voluntary markets, Carbon offset mechanisms, arbon markets / carbon trading in Indonesia.
